svg.text: Plotting stored forecasts: three slices of one field
Same synthetic data throughout — a new forecast every 3 h, each reaching 24 h ahead, over three days.
The data is a field, not a series
Every cell is one forecast: what was said at an issue time about a valid time. Each plot below cuts it a different way.
Pale cells are empty by construction: a forecast never speaks about the past.
A — fix the issue time (a row)
“What did we think then?” One issue’s whole horizon, drawn against what actually happened.
B — fix the valid time (a column)
“How did our view of one moment settle as it approached?” The x axis is issue time, not valid time.
issue time → (24 h before … the moment itself)
served today by ?valid_from=..;valid_to=.. over a narrow window
C — fix the lead time (a diagonal)
“How good is the four-hours-ahead view a controller actually consumes?”
NOT served well today — would want a ?lead=<seconds> shape
